summary: Diginex Limited, a London-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice of an Extraordinary General Meeting set for November 20, 2026, with materials mailed on or about November 12, 2026. The EGM seeks approval of an authorized share capital increase from US$200,000 (495,000,000 ordinary shares) to US$520,000 (1,295,000,000 ordinary shares), a related memorandum amendment, and a new share consolidation, each conditioned on a previously approved Transaction not closing first. No price, stake, premium, advisor recommendation, or deal economics are disclosed; this is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation.
